sources.notes: Verified 35 sitemap pages explicitly listed in sitemap.xml. Prefer business-relevant occupancy, hotel economics, regulation, transport access and demand; exclude consumer hotel recommendations, vacation lists and entertainment from training corpus. Association statements are attributed claims, not independent proof. No access-control bypass on 403. Sampled sitemap page 35 includes /node/ and newsletter URLs excluded by article regex; strict /article/ links are confirmed on news listing. Do not count every sitemap entry as an article.

recommended_collection_window.reason: Historical training corpus; use explicit run as_of and article publication evidence. These are recommendations; collector CLI must enforce the actual window.

exclusion_policy.explicit_patterns: Quarantine matches with source_id, pattern and title recorded; do not relabel as relevance zero.
exclusion_policy.fuzzy_genre: Retain genre_unknown for human review; source reputation alone does not establish editorial independence.
exclusion_policy.preserve_hard_negatives: Do not exclude genuine small/local business events solely for low relevance or limited scale.
